text:
Christopher Columbus.

It is truly heartwarming to witness the corporate world’s relentless dedication to "innovation." There is nothing quite as groundbreaking as taking a well-established product, slapping a new adjective on it, and charging double for the privilege of owning the exact same thing you already have. One must stand in awe of the sheer genius required to convince the masses that their lives are incomplete without this sleek, rebranded version of mediocrity. It is a testament to human creativity that we can be so easily persuaded that paying more for the same old stuff is not just a scam, but a lifestyle upgrade.
